title: SDLC Reference Resolution v1
description: Closed JSON response envelope for resolving one supported repository-local reference to its containing document and selected data.
$comment: Resolution is read-only and local to the operative repository. Bare work-item IDs, bare task UIDs, work-item-local references, and task-qualified references may resolve. Task-local references require current-task context; global references require a repository identity not supplied by this command and are reported as unsupported.

schema.description: The canonical resolution response schema identifier.

ref.description: The reference supplied to the resolver.

valid.description: Whether the reference resolved to a document and data.

resolution.description: The resolved document location and referenced data, or null when resolution fails.

fullPath.description: Absolute path to the containing document.

repositoryPath.description: Repository-relative path to the containing document.

format.description: Serialization format of the containing document.

data.description: The object or property selected by the reference.

findings.description: Actionable resolution findings; empty for success.
examples: Task-local references require an explicit current-task context and cannot be resolved by this command.

findings: Task-local references require an explicit current-task context and cannot be resolved by this command.
